description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Language' class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically in the Catalog Controller Startup namespace. It manages language selection, loading, and overrides for the catalog part of the application.
published: Opencart	il ramework	rait ase aseController::index
Opencart	il ramework	rait ase aseController::after

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Manages language selection, loading, and customization for the OpenCart catalog frontend, including default language setup and override capabilities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the language settings for the catalog, loads available languages, sets default language based on configuration or request parameters, and loads language files.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Overrides default language values after initial loading, ensuring the correct language is used based on route, prefix, or user preference.
